content: Show me the spacer with the taper applied.

Here is the spacer with the taper applied - 10 mm across the foot, 6 mm across the top, 5 mm tall:

```stl
solid spacer
  facet normal 0.0 0.0 -1.0
    outer loop
      vertex -0.5 -0.5 0
      vertex 0.5 0.5 0
      vertex 0.5 -0.5 0
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal 0.0 0.0 -1.0
    outer loop
      vertex -0.5 -0.5 0
      vertex -0.5 0.5 0
      vertex 0.5 0.5 0
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal 0.0 0.0 1.0
    outer loop
      vertex -0.3 -0.3 0.5
      vertex 0.3 -0.3 0.5
      vertex 0.3 0.3 0.5
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal 0.0 0.0 1.0
    outer loop
      vertex -0.3 -0.3 0.5
      vertex 0.3 0.3 0.5
      vertex -0.3 0.3 0.5
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal 0.0 -0.9285 0.3714
    outer loop
      vertex -0.5 -0.5 0
      vertex 0.5 -0.5 0
      vertex 0.3 -0.3 0.5
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal 0.0 -0.9285 0.3714
    outer loop
      vertex -0.5 -0.5 0
      vertex 0.3 -0.3 0.5
      vertex -0.3 -0.3 0.5
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal 0.9285 -0.0 0.3714
    outer loop
      vertex 0.5 -0.5 0
      vertex 0.5 0.5 0
      vertex 0.3 0.3 0.5
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal 0.9285 0.0 0.3714
    outer loop
      vertex 0.5 -0.5 0
      vertex 0.3 0.3 0.5
      vertex 0.3 -0.3 0.5
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal 0.0 0.9285 0.3714
    outer loop
      vertex 0.5 0.5 0
      vertex -0.5 0.5 0
      vertex -0.3 0.3 0.5
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal 0.0 0.9285 0.3714
    outer loop
      vertex 0.5 0.5 0
      vertex -0.3 0.3 0.5
      vertex 0.3 0.3 0.5
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal -0.9285 0.0 0.3714
    outer loop
      vertex -0.5 0.5 0
      vertex -0.5 -0.5 0
      vertex -0.3 -0.3 0.5
    endloop
  endfacet
  facet normal -0.9285 0.0 0.3714
    outer loop
      vertex -0.5 0.5 0
      vertex -0.3 -0.3 0.5
      vertex -0.3 0.3 0.5
    endloop
  endfacet
endsolid spacer
```

The taper keeps the walls at about 22 degrees, inside what the printer handles without supports.
